release_notes:
Including a snippet is easier with a big library: Insert variable › Another snippet… now opens a searchable list. Type part of a trigger or name, pick with the arrow keys and press Enter

A preview shows the selected snippet's text and how long it is, and scrolls for long snippets. Disabled snippets are no longer offered

Long dropdowns, such as Folder in the editor, now show 10 rows and scroll instead of running off the screen
